evidence_type: Bounded public-source research for a headset read command covering game/spatial state; no device writes performed
question: Does Studio H1 expose a queryable game/spatial state, or only button push events?
searched: Installed phone packages: no Realme Link / official Realme companion found; present were GadgetBridge, H1 Control fork and the earlier minimal app.

Jieli-Tech/Android-JL_Bluetooth public repo, default branch main, 2433 files; 26 RCSP-related paths. Docs cover noise-processing mode callbacks and generic sendCommandAsync, but no game-mode, spatial-audio or work-mode read command.

Upstream H1 Control tools/probe: scripts only write `0xC0 02 05 xx` work-mode values and raw `85 86 87` frames; `restore.swift` reverts those writes. `listen.swift` only observes button-induced pushes.
Web search attempt failed with HTTP 402; no result obtained from that channel.

confirmed: H1 Control APK has no game/spatial query: REA ev_ad63…, ev_72ce…
Game/spatial values set only from RealmeEvent feature 4/5: REA ev_8b5d…, ev_0c9f…
Status op=07 contains battery, noise and supported modes only: REA ev_5fd6…
unresolved: Whether some other firmware revision or vendor app has a game/spatial read command
Whether JieLi ADV work mode 0xC0 02 05 xx reflects game mode; upstream only wrote values and reverted them
not_proven: Absence of every possible query command on the headset

safe_next_step: Owner toggles game mode on H1 while the fork is open; agent reads bounded logcat for the resulting RealmeEvent frame. No opcode writes without a separate, explicit reversible-test decision.
